name: Go to Beginning
description: jumps back to the start of the score.

name: Previous Bar
description: moves back one bar.

name: Play
description: starts the music and the page follows along. It becomes a Pause button while playing.

name: Next Bar
description: moves forward one bar.

name: Metronome
description: switches the click on or off.

name: Key
description: opens the key menu for a backing track or karaoke file, to move the music up or down in semitones.

name: Down a Tone
description: in the key menu, lowers the music by two semitones.

name: Up a Tone
description: in the key menu, raises the music by two semitones.

name: Edit Score
description: opens the score editor.

name: Annotate
description: draw on the page with Apple Pencil.

name: Wait for Me
description: the music waits until it hears you play the next note.

name: Record Myself
description: records you with the microphone so you can review the take.

name: Tuner
description: tells you how far in tune the note you play is.

name: Inspector
description: opens the panel with this score's settings: key, tempo, backing tracks, staves and appearance.

name: Chord View
description: shows the chords of the score as a grid.

name: Show Lyrics Instead of Music
description: swaps the page for the words.

name: Play Together
description: plays in time with other devices.

name: Zoom In
description: makes the music bigger.

name: Zoom Out
description: makes the music smaller.

name: Fit to Width
description: sizes the page to fill the screen width.

name: Follow Playback
description: scrolls the page to keep the playing bar in view.

name: Dark Sheet Music
description: shows light notes on a dark page.

name: Turn Pages Like a Book
description: pages turn with a curl instead of scrolling.

name: Highlight Notes
description: lights up each note as it sounds.

name: Highlight Bar
description: washes the playing bar with colour.

name: Moving Line
description: draws a line that travels along the music.

name: More
description: the rest of the commands for this score.

name: Settings
description: appearance, playing, listening, accessibility and shortcuts.

name: Help
description: opens this guide.

name: Add
description: add a score, a set-list or a file.

name: Import Score
description: brings a PDF, MusicXML or other score into the library.

name: Scan Sheet Music
description: photographs a printed page and reads it.

name: New Blank Score
description: starts an empty score to write in.

name: Search Scores
description: finds classical pieces and jazz tunes to download.

name: Scales & Arpeggios
description: makes a practice score for a scale or arpeggio in any key.

name: New Set-List
description: makes a list of scores to play in order.

name: Tracks from GitHub
description: downloads scores and tracks from a GitHub repository.

name: Print
description: prints the score.

name: Export as PDF
description: saves the page as a PDF.

name: Export as MusicXML
description: saves the notes as a MusicXML file.

name: Export Video
description: makes a movie of the music following along.

name: Rename
description: changes the score's name.

name: Duplicate
description: makes a copy of the score.

name: Delete from Library
description: removes the score.

name: Listen
description: plays the music from the chosen note or bar. It becomes a Stop button while playing.

name: Help
description: opens this guide at the editor pages.

name: Undo
description: takes back the last change.

name: Redo
description: puts back a change you undid.

name: Options
description: the sound used for listening, beats per bar, editing with the Pencil only, history and more.

name: History
description: saved versions and branches of the score.

name: Deselect
description: clears whatever is chosen. It shows in the middle of the toolbar while something is chosen.

name: Notes
description: put in and move notes, and set how long they last.

name: Rests
description: add, change and remove rests.

name: Marks
description: accidentals, ties and articulations.

name: Dynamics
description: loud and soft, crescendo and diminuendo.

name: Bars
description: repeat signs, and adding or removing bars.

name: Form
description: first and second time bars, jumps and tempo.

name: Medley
description: copy, cut, paste and insert bars, even from other scores.

name: Erase
description: rub out notes and rests.

name: Draw
description: write over the music with Apple Pencil.

name: Close
description: the red button closes the editing window.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: window buttons

name: Minimise
description: the yellow button shrinks the window to its title bar. Double-tap the title bar to bring it back.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: window buttons

name: Fit to Contents
description: the green button sizes the window to show everything in it.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: window buttons

name: Back
description: goes back from a submenu to the list.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: window buttons

name: Sharp
description: puts a sharp on the chosen notes.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Flat
description: puts a flat on the chosen notes.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Natural
description: puts a natural on the chosen notes.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Tie to the Next Note
description: joins a note to the next one of the same pitch.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Dotted
description: makes the note half as long again.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Copy Notes
description: copies the chosen notes.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Cut Notes
description: copies the chosen notes and removes them.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Paste Notes
description: opens a choice. Overwrite writes the copied notes over the ones already there and removes them. Insert puts them into new bars after this one.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Duplicate Notes
description: opens a choice: Inline puts the copy straight after, On Stave Below or To Stave Above puts it on the next staff, and To New Stave makes a new staff for it.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Turn into a Rest
description: replaces the chosen notes with a rest. For a rest, it takes the rest off the page.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Half as Long
description: halves the length of the chosen notes.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Twice as Long
description: doubles the length of the chosen notes.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Pitch
description: three rows of buttons to move the chosen notes up or down by a Half Step, a Full Step or an Octave.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Up
description: raises the notes by the step named in its row.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Down
description: lowers the notes by the step named in its row.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Up an Octave
description: raises the notes by an octave.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Down an Octave
description: lowers the notes by an octave.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Generate Harmony
description: writes a harmony a third, fourth, fifth, sixth or octave above or below on an empty staff, or a new one.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Select All Notes
description: chooses every note in the piece.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Select All Notes on Staff
description: chooses every note on one staff.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Select All Bars
description: chooses every bar, so bar actions apply to all of them.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Articulation
description: staccato, accent, tenuto, marcato, fermata and more.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Dynamic
description: sets a dynamic at the note, from ppp to fff.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Follow the Key Signature
description: takes off a note's own accidental so the key signature decides.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Bar
description: opens the settings for the note's bar in a second window.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: notes

name: Copy Bar
description: copies the chosen bars.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Cut Bar
description: copies the chosen bars and removes them.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Paste Bars
description: opens a choice. Overwrite replaces the chosen bars with the copied ones. Insert puts the copied bars in after the chosen ones.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Duplicate
description: opens a choice of Inline, On Stave Below, To Stave Above or To New Stave.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Delete Bar
description: removes the chosen bars. The last bar of a piece always stays.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Repeat start
description: puts a repeat sign at the start of the bar.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Repeat end
description: puts a repeat sign at the end of the bar, and cycles through the number of times.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Add a bar after
description: adds an empty bar after this one.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Add Bar After
description: adds an empty bar after the chosen bar.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Add Bar Before
description: adds an empty bar before the chosen bar.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Select Content
description: chooses all the notes in the chosen bars.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Crescendo and Diminuendo
description: puts a hairpin over the bar.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Longer
description: stretches a hairpin or bracket over more bars.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Shorter
description: shortens a hairpin or bracket.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: First and Second Time Bars
description: first time, second time and bracket length.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Jumps and Signs
description: Segno, Coda, To Coda, D.C., D.S. and Fine.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Insert from Score
description: takes bars from another score in your library.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Expand Repeats
description: writes the piece out as it is played.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: All Staves
description: actions that take the bar from every staff at once.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Add Treble Staff
description: adds a staff with a treble clef.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Add Bass Staff
description: adds a staff with a bass clef.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Delete Staff
description: removes one staff and its notes, leaving the others.
where: Buttons & Icons: The editing window: bars

name: Mute
description: silences a staff while the music plays.

name: Solo
description: plays only the staves marked Solo.

description: takes a staff off the page. It stays off in exported and printed PDFs, so you can print one part.
